Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting liability for specified state and local agencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to governmental liability; and adding new sectionsto chapter 4.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A law enforcement agency, and its officers, agents, and employees,shall not be liable for injuries to persons or property resulting fromany act or omission of the agency, officer, agent, or employee, whileacting in the course and scope of official duties, unless the act oromission constitutes intentional, or willful and wanton, misconduct.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of corrections, and its agents, officers, andemployees, and the department of social and health services, and itsagents, officers, and employees, shall not be liable for injuries topersons or property resulting from an act or omission of the agency,officer, agent, or employee, while acting in the course and scope of p. 1 HB 1580official duties, unless the act or omission constitutes intentional, orwillful and wanton, misconduct.
